Selina 任家萱 Portrait

Selina 任家萱 appears seated in a softly lit interior, her long black hair cascading over her shoulders as she rests her chin on her hand. She wears a dark, patterned top and a red bracelet, conveying a calm and introspective mood. The close-up framing emphasizes her thoughtful expression and smooth complexion.

This portrait accompanies the release of her new EP "重作一個夢," whose second single "夢" was composed by Jay Chou. Selina wrote the lyrics over six months to capture her emotions from the past year. Selina 任家萱 Discusses Second Child Plans

Selina 任家萱, known for her role in the girl group SHE, has endured a dramatic journey from a near-fatal on-set explosion in 2010 to a triumphant return to entertainment. After extensive surgeries and rehabilitation, she married Zhang Chengzhong in 2011, though the marriage ended in 2016. She later found new love in 2022 and welcomed her son in September 2023.

Selina’s Moment on Variety Show

Selina (任家萱) sits comfortably on a talk show set, her hands gently clasped as she smiles at the camera. She wears a brown blouse and eye-catching heart-shaped earrings, with a discreet microphone attached to her cheek. Lush green plants and warm lighting in the background lend a cozy, inviting feel to the scene.

The on-screen text “肆意家族 任家萱 Selina” identifies her by both her Chinese name and English stage name.
